help.profiles.click: Click a card to use that profile.
help.profiles.menu: Right-click a card, click its ⋯ button, or press m / Shift+F10 on a focused card to open its action menu.
help.profiles.menuControls: Menu: ↑↓ / j/k selects; Home / End jumps to the first/last item; Enter runs it. Esc / Tab / Shift+Tab or an outside click closes.
help.messages.toast: Subscription changes, core restarts and errors appear in the upper-right. Open a notice there for details. While browsing, Ctrl+N expands the list when there are notifications.
help.messages.dismiss: Errors remain until closed. Cancel on a progress notice stops its task; closing the notice keeps it running. Browsing remains available during tasks; follow the current dialog hint for dialog tasks.
